content: Low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol management and treatment goals, as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), emphasize the importance of achieving optimal lipid levels to reduce cardiovascular risk. In certain cases, combination therapy involving ezetimibe or proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors may be recommended to further lower LDL cholesterol levels, particularly in individuals who do not achieve target levels with statin therapy alone. The use of high-intensity statin therapy has been demonstrated to significantly decrease the incidence of cardiovascular events in individuals classified as being at high risk for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
